## Activity

During October 2024, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 389 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing the site’s operational performance during the month. The volume of completed captures should continue to be monitored alongside image quality and grading outcomes to identify any emerging operational issues.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 20 were marked ungradable. The ungradable_rate was 5.1. This result should be reviewed as part of routine quality monitoring. Where recurring camera issues are identified, the clinic team should record them and log them with the service desk. This will support follow-up and help determine whether further technical action is required.

## Grading

A total of 105 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2. The grading results and waiting time should be considered with the activity and image quality measures when reviewing service performance for October 2024. Continued monitoring will help the clinic identify changes in referral outcomes, image quality, or grading timeliness and support appropriate local action.
